outcome: Circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) protein levels
Cerebellar maturation (Ki-67-positive portion of EGL, Purkinje cell calbindin staining, sonic hedgehog staining)
cohort: The study included preterm rabbit pups delivered by cesarean section at day 29 of gestation and control term pups delivered by spontaneous vaginal delivery at day 32 of gestation.
finding: Preterm birth in rabbit pups is associated with lower circulating levels of IGF-1, decreased postnatal growth, and decreased cerebellar external granular layer (EGL) proliferation and Purkinje cell maturation.
mod_finding: Preterm pups were delivered by cesarean section, while term control pups were delivered by spontaneous vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Mean weight of pups was lower in the preterm group compared to the term group at all time points.
